Which statements about the Periodic Table are correct?
1
The horizontal rows of the Periodic Table are called groups.
2
The Periodic Table is arranged in order of increasing proton number.
3
The elements in the second column from the left of the Periodic Table form ions with
a charge of 2+.
4
Elements in a horizontal row of the Periodic Table become more metallic going from
left to right.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
3 and 4
